title: chaenactis heterocarpha var. tanacetifolia
intro: Chaenactis heterocarpha var. tanacetifolia, commonly known as tansy-leaved Chaenactis, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with colds, fever, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Chaenactis heterocarpha var. tanacetifolia include its ability to act as an antiseptic and a diuretic, which may help reduce fever, relieve headaches, and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
